name: Large Language Models
description: Course introduction, introduction to natural language processing, introduction to language models: statistical language modeling, introduction to language models: advanced smoothing and evaluation, word vectors, neural language models, introduction to transformer (self-attention, multi-head attention positional encoding, layer normalization), pre-training strategies, advanced attention, Tokenization strategies, mixture of experts, scaling laws, pre-training of causal LMs and in-context learning, instruction tuning, alignment of language models (PPO, DPO, GRPO, etc.), parameter efficient fine-tuning, quantization, pruning and distillation, efficient LLM decoding, retrieval-based language models, multimodal models, tool augmentation, reasoning in LLMs, long context LLMs, knowledge editing, self-evolving LLMs, an alternate formulation of transformers, bias and interpretability.
